caption:
Huge photos are a top reason pages load slowly. 🐢

1. Resize the photo to the size your page needs
2. Compress it with a free tool or plugin like Smush
3. Upload the smaller file

scenes.text: Your website feels slow? Look at your photos.
scenes.sub: Big images are a common cause.
scenes.say: Your website feels slow? Look at your photos. Big images are a common cause.
A photo straight from your camera is huge. A resized and compressed one loads much faster.

scenes.title: Shrink every image
items: Resize to the size you need
scenes.say: Resize the photo to the size you actually need. Compress it. Then upload it.

scenes.title: Let a plugin do it for you
scenes.body: A free plugin like Smush can compress on upload.
scenes.say: Want it automatic? A free plugin like Smush can compress your images when you upload them.

scenes.title: Reload the page after
scenes.body: Make sure the images still look sharp.
scenes.say: Then reload the page and make sure your images still look sharp.
